safi-cedvel:34-34.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq) (إليكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزلنا), (مثلا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «آيات» by the wāw, accusative (manṣūb) (من الذين) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (مثلا), (من قبلكم) attached to (خلوا), (موعظة) conjoined to «آيات» by the wāw, accusative (للمتّقين) attached to (موعظة) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted adjective of «موعظة».]».
The clause «أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response (jawāb) to the implied oath.
The clause «خلوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).

* Morphology:
(مبيّنات), plural of مبيّنة, the feminine of مبيّن, an active participle from the quadriliteral بيّن; its pattern is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:35-35.t:
* I'rab:
(كمشكاة) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (مثل) (فيها) attached to a fronted predicate of the mubtadaʾ (مصباح), (في زجاجة) predicate of the mubtadaʾ (المصباح), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb (يوقد) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as «هو», referring to «المصباح» (من شجرة) attached to (يوقد) with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. «من زيت شجرة» (مباركة، زيتونة، لا شرقيّة) adjectives of «شجرة», genitive (majrūr) (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation (غربيّة) conjoined to «شرقيّة» by the wāw (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle (نور) predicate of an omitted subject, its implied form being «هو» (على نور) attached to an adjective of the first «نور» (لنوره) attached to (يهدي), (للناس) attached to (يضرب), and (بكلّ) attached to (عليم), which is a nominative predicate.
The clause «الله نور السموات ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «مثل نوره كمشكاة ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «فيها مصباح ...» is in the position of genitive, an adjective of «مشكاة».
The clause «المصباح في زجاجة» is in the position of nominative, an adjective of «مصباح».
The clause «الزجاجة كأنها ...» is in the position of genitive, an adjective of «زجاجة» «[Note: It may be parenthetical between the subject and its second predicate.]».
The clause «كأنّها كوكب ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of the subject (الزجاجة).
The clause «يوقد ...» is in the position of nominative, a second predicate of «المصباح».
The clause «يكاد زيتها ...» is in the position of genitive, an adjective of «شجرة» «[Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «شجرة», since it has been described.]».
The clause «يضيء ...» is in the position of accusative, predicate of «يكاد».
The clause «لم تمسسه نار ...» is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of the agent of «يضيء».
The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: «لو لم تمسسه نار يكاد يضيء».
The clause «(هو) نور ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, reinforcing the content of what preceded.
The clause «يهدي الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يضرب الله ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «يهدي».
The clause «الله.. عليم» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: Or conjoined to the clause «يهدي الله».]».

* Morphology:
(مشكاة), a name for a niche that does not go through, or for the tube in the middle of a lamp; its pattern is مفعلة, with kasra on the mīm, on the pattern of the noun of instrument, from (شكا). It contains a phonological change (iʿlāl), since its origin is مشكوة: the wāw was vowelled after a fatḥa and changed into alif. There are many views about the meaning of «المشكاة».
(مصباح), a noun of instrument derived irregularly from the intransitive triliteral (صبح); its pattern is مفعال, with kasra on the mīm.
(زجاجة), the singular of «الزجاج», a collective generic noun; it is well known. Its pattern is فعالة, with ḍamma on the fāʾ; it is said that kasra and fatḥa are also permissible on the fāʾ, and likewise in «الزجاج».
(درّيّ), a relative adjective (nisba) attributed to «الدرّ», the well-known gem, for its brightness and lustre; the pattern of «دريّ» is فعليّ, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(غربيّة), feminine of «غربيّ», a relative adjective attributed to «الغرب»; its pattern is فعليّة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(زيتها), a name for the liquid used as a condiment, extracted from olives and other things; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- The loose simile (al-tashbīh al-mursal): in the words of the Exalted «مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكاةٍ فِيها مِصْباحٌ..» to the end of the verse. The simile here comes by means of the particle, namely the kāf. What is meant is that the light to which the Truth is likened is a multiplied light, in which the niche, the glass, the lamp and the oil have all combined, so that nothing remains of what strengthens the light, increases its radiance and supplies it with brightness. For when the lamp is in a narrow place such as the niche, it is brighter and more concentrated in its light, unlike a wide place, in which the light disperses and spreads.
Al-Karkhī excelled in defining this representational simile (tashbīh tamthīlī), saying: «Allah has likened His light, i.e. the knowledge of Him in the heart of the believer, to the light of the lamp rather than the light of the sun, even though the sun's light is more complete, because what is intended is to represent the light in the heart, the heart in the breast and the breast in the body, by the lamp, the lamp in the glass and the glass in the lantern.
[Translator's note: the closing quotation mark of al-Karkhī's quotation is missing in the source.]
2- Antithesis (al-ṭibāq): in the words of the Exalted «لا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلا غَرْبِيَّةٍ». The scholars of rhetoric have spoken much about this antithesis. Al-Zamakhsharī said: It was said: neither in a sunny spot (maḍḥā) nor in a shady spot (maqnaʾa) «which is the place on which the sun does not rise», but sun and shade alternate upon it, and that is better for its fruit-bearing and purer for its oil.
The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) said: «There is no good in a tree in a shady spot, nor in a plant in a shady spot, nor is there good in them in a sunny spot».
And it was said: it is not something on which the sun falls only at the time of its rising or its setting; rather it reaches it both morning and evening, so it is both eastern and western.
3- Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in the words of the Exalted «نُورٌ عَلى نُورٍ»:
A kind of grandeur and hyperbole, than which nothing is more elegant or more beautiful. For it is not a single light, specified or unspecified, above another light like it, nor is it the sum of only two lights; rather it expresses a multiplied light without limit, its multiplication not being restricted to a definite degree.
4- Linking of the extremities (tashābuh al-aṭrāf): this is when the speaker looks to a word that occurs at the end of a sentence of a passage in prose, or to the last word at the end of the first hemistich in verse, and begins with it.
Consider the linking of the extremities of these successive sentences: «اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكاةٍ فِيها مِصْباحٌ الْمِصْباحُ فِي زُجاجَةٍ، الزُّجاجَةُ كَأَنَّها كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ».

* Benefits:
- اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ.
We have often dealt with the parable (al-mathal) and its role in the style of the Noble Qur'an, and in establishing the teachings and principles of Islam by means of the parable. The parable reaches its summit in this noble verse, which depicts the light of Allah that encompasses all beings, in a depiction before whose splendid artistry thought almost stands dumbfounded. Were it not for fear of departing from the book's plan of brevity, we would have preferred to write pages about this simile and the splendour and artistry in it.
But the reader need only stand before its splendour and contemplate at length the eloquence of the Qur'an and its inimitability.

safi-cedvel:36-38.t:
* I'rab:
(في بيوت) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسبّح), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb (ترفع) is a pronoun referring to «بيوت» (الواو) conjunction (فيها) attached to (يذكر), (اسمه) deputy agent of the verb «يذكر»..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ترفع) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. «في أن ترفع», attached to (أذن), (له) attached to (يسبّح), (فيها), the second one, attached to (يسبّح), emphasising the first prepositional phrase «في بيوت» (بالغدوّ) attached to (يسبّح).
The clause «أذن الله ...» is in the position of genitive, a naʿt (adjective) of «بيوت».
The clause «ترفع ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «يذكر فيها اسمه ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «يسبّح ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
37- 38- (رجال) fāʿil (agent) of «يسبّح», nominative (marfūʿ) (لا) negating, and the second one is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation, and (بيع) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «تجارة» by the wāw (عن ذكر) attached to (تلهيهم), (يوما) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) (فيه) attached to (تتقلّب), (اللام) the most evident view is that it is the lām of consequence (lām al-ʿāqiba) (يجزيهم) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, the referring pronoun being omitted, i.e. «عملوه», and the clause after it is its ṣila.]».
The interpreted maṣdar (ما عملوا..) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يجزيهم..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يسبّح) or attached to (يخافون) «[Note: It may be attached to an omitted verb.. i.e.: «فعلوا ذلك ليجزيهم».]».
(من فضله) attached to (يزيدهم), (الواو) resumptive (بغير) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «يرزق».
The clause «لا تلهيهم تجارة ...» is in the position of nominative, an adjective of «رجال».
The clause «يخافون ...» is in the position of nominative, a second adjective of «رجال» «[Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the object pronoun in «تلهيهم», or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.]».
The clause «تتقلّب فيه القلوب» is in the position of accusative, an adjective of (يوما).
The clause «يجزيهم الله..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «يزيدهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «يجزيهم».
The clause «الله يرزق ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, having the force of a statement of cause (taʿlīl).
The clause «يرزق ...» is in the position of nominative, khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الله).
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).

* Benefits:
The words of the Exalted «فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ etc.»: the grammarians have said a great deal about the attachment of the prepositional phrase «في بيوت». The reason for this disagreement is the long separation between the attached element and what it is attached to. Despite the extent of the disagreement and the multiplicity of views, we select for you the most important of them:
a- [It was said] that they are attached to an adjective of «المشكاة». [Translator's note: the source reads «مثل بأنهما» here, apparently a misprint for «قيل بأنهما» ("it was said that they").]
b- It was said: to an adjective of «المصباح».
c- It was said: they are attached to the verb «يوقد». d- It was said: to an omitted element, its implied form being «سبحوه في بيوت». e- It was said that they are attached to a «ḥāl» of the lamp, the glass and the star, its implied form being «وهو في بيوت».
And it was said that they are attached to «توقد», i.e. «توقد في بيوت». [Translator's note: the source reads «ووقيل», apparently a misprint, with the letter of this item fused into the word.]
So choose from among these opinions whatever pleases you and what you find closest to good taste and to reality.
The truth is that the length of the separation makes us prefer to assume an omitted element, rather than take the attachment back to the beginning of the verse, which fills half a page and more.

safi-cedvel:39-40.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (كسراب) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أعمالهم» «[Note: It may be the predicate of the relative noun (الذين) كفروا.. with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. «أعمال الذين كفروا..», in which case (أعمالهم) is parsed as a badal (substitute) of the relative noun, according to the view of al-Qurṭubī.]», (بقيعة) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (سراب) (ماء) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb «يحسبه» (حتّى) a particle of inception (ḥarf ibtidāʾ) (شيئا) second direct object of the verb «يجده» «[Note: I.e. he did not find what he had reckoned to be anything.]», (عنده) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to (وجد), i.e. «لقي» (met), (الواو) parenthetical..
The clause «الذين كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين), and the clause «أعمالهم كسراب ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of the subject (الذين).
The clause «يحسبه الظمآن ...» is in the position of genitive, an adjective of «سراب»; the clause «جاءه ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause «لم يجده شيئا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «وجد الله ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied (muqaddar) clause «[Note: The implied clause is the outcome of the representational simile, i.e.: and the disbeliever, when death comes to him, does not find his deeds after death, and finds Allah's reckoning, or His punishment, or His judgement, at his deeds.. so Allah pays him his account in full.]».
The clause «وفّاه ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «وجد الله..».
The clause «الله سريع ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical «[Note: Or a resumption having the force of a statement of cause (taʿlīl).]».
40- (أو) a conjunction (كظلمات) attached to what «كسراب» is attached to, being maʿṭūf (conjoined) to it (في بحر) attached to an adjective of (ظلمات) (من فوقه) attached to a fronted predicate of the subject (موج), the second one (من فوقه) attached to a fronted predicate of the subject (سحاب) (ظلمات) predicate of an omitted subject, its implied form being «هي» or «هذه» (فوق) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to the predicate of the subject «بعضها» (الواو) conjunction, and the sign of the jussive in the verb (يجعل) is the sukūn, given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters (له) attached to a second direct object (الفاء) linking the apodosis (له), the second one, attached to a fronted predicate (نور) genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed subject.
The clause «يغشاه موج» is in the position of genitive, an adjective of «بحر» «[Note: It may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «بحر», because it has been described.]».
The clause «من فوقه موج» is in the position of nominative, an adjective of the first «موج».
The clause «من فوقه سحاب» is in the position of nominative, an adjective of the second «موج».
The clause «(هي) ظلمات ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «بعضها فوق بعض» is in the position of nominative, an adjective of «ظلمات».
The clause «أخرج ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لم يكد يراها ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يراها» is in the position of accusative, predicate of «يكد».
The clause «من لم يجعل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «(هي) ظلمات».
The clause «لم يجعل الله ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of the subject (من) «[Note: The predicate may be the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «ما له من نور» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(سراب), a name for what is seen in the hot daytime as though it were water.
(قيعة), a noun which is the plural of «قاع»: level, low-lying land; its pattern is فعلة, with kasra then sukūn. There are other plurals, among them «قيعان» and «أقواع».
(الظمآن), an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from ظمئ يظمأ, of the bāb of فرح; its pattern is فعلان, with fatḥa then sukūn; its feminine is «ظمأى», and its plural «ظماء», with kasra on the ẓāʾ.
(لجّيّ), a relative adjective (nisba) attributed to «اللجّ» or «اللّجة», which is abundant water or the main body of the sea; its pattern is فعليّ, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- The representational simile (al-tashbīh al-tamthīlī): in the words of the Exalted «أَعْمالُهُمْ كَسَرابٍ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ الظَّمْآنُ ماءً». He likened the righteous deeds done by one who does not hold faith and does not follow the truth — deeds he reckons will benefit him with Allah and save him from His punishment, but which in the end disappoint his hope, so that he meets the opposite of what he had reckoned — to a mirage which the disbeliever sees on the plain of resurrection (al-sāhira), overcome by thirst on the Day of Resurrection; he takes it for water and comes to it, but does not find what he hoped for, and finds Allah's guardians of Hell (al-zabāniya) at it, who seize him, drag him to Hell and give him boiling water and pus to drink. They are those of whom Allah said: «عامِلَةٌ ناصِبَةٌ» «وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعاً».
2- Conjunction to an omitted element: in the words of the Exalted «وَوَجَدَ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ».
The clause is not conjoined to (لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْئاً), but to what is understood from it by way of the representation: that the disbelievers find of their mentioned deeds neither substance nor trace, as in the words of the Exalted:
«وَقَدِمْنا إِلى ما عَمِلُوا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْناهُ هَباءً مَنْثُوراً». It is as though it were said: until, when the disbelievers come on the Day of Resurrection to their deeds, which in this world they reckoned would benefit them in the Hereafter, they find them to be nothing, and find Allah's judgement and decree lying in wait for them.

* Benefits:
«من» and its kinds:
«من» comes in four kinds: a- interrogative «من».
b- conditional «من».
c- relative «من».
d- «من» as an indefinite noun that is described.
Each of these four kinds has conditions and details.. We have already explained this in several places, so go back to it, for in repetition there is every benefit.

safi-cedvel:41-42.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation, and the sign of the jussive (majzūm) in (تر) is the dropping of the weak letter (له) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسبّح), (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent) (في السموات) attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «من».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله يسبّح..) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «ترى».
(الواو) conjunction (الطير) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the relative noun that is the agent, (من), (صافّات) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الطير», accusative (manṣūba), the sign of the accusative being the kasra (كلّ) mubtadaʾ (subject) — with the annexation intended — (قد) for realisation (taḥqīq), and the agent of (علم) is a pronoun referring to «كلّ» «[Note: It was said that it refers to Allah, i.e. Allah knows his prayer.]», i.e. each one of them knows his own prayer (الواو) resumptive (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun, the referring pronoun being omitted, i.e. «يفعلونه», and the clause after it is its ṣila.]».
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يفعلون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (predicate) (عليم).
The clause «لم تر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يسبّح ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of «أنّ».
The clause «كلّ قد علم ...» is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of the relative noun (من) and what is conjoined to it.
The clause «علم ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of the subject (كلّ).
The clause «الله عليم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يفعلون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما).
42- (الواو) conjunction (لله) attached to a fronted predicate of the subject (ملك), (الواو) conjunction (إلى الله) attached to a fronted predicate.
The clause «لله ملك ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «الله عليم».
The clause «إلى الله المصير» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «الله عليم».

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(ألم تر.. يزجي) like the previous verse «[Note: In verse (41) of this sūra.]», (ثمّ) a conjunction in both places (بينه) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤلّف) «[Note: I.e. He joins together its pieces.]», (ركاما) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (الفاء) conjunction (من خلاله) attached to (يخرج), (الواو) conjunction (من السماء) attached to (ينزّل), and (من) is for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya) (من جبال) attached to (ينزّل), being a badal (substitute) of «السماء» with repetition of the preposition, and (من) is for the beginning of the extent; it is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) «[Note: According to some it is partitive and attached to (ينزّل), i.e. «something of mountains», and Abū al-Baqāʾ chose this..
According to some it is redundant (zāʾida) and (جبال) is the object of «ينزّل»; this is the view of al-Akhfash.]», (فيها) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (جبال), and the pronoun refers to «السماء» (من برد) attached to (ينزّل), and (من) is partitive «[Note: Or (من) is redundant and (برد) is a direct object.]», (الفاء) conjunction (به) attached to (يصيب), (عمّن) attached to (يصرفه), (بالأبصار) attached to (يذهب), and (الباء) is for making the verb transitive (taʿdiya) «[Note: Or it has the sense of «من», and the object is omitted, i.e. it takes the light away from the eyes.]».
The clause «لم تر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يزجي ...» is in the position of nominative, khabar (predicate) of «أنّ».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله يزجي ...) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «ترى».
The clause «يؤلّف ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «يزجي».
The clause «يجعله ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «يؤلّف».
The clause «ترى ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يخرج ...» is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الودق».
The clause «ينزّل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «ترى الودق» «[Note: Or conjoined to the clause «يزجي», in the position of nominative; likewise the clause «يصيب» and the clause «يصرفه».]».
The clause «يصيب ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «ينزّل».
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يصرفه ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «يصيب».
The clause «يشاء (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
The clause «يكاد ...» is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of «الودق» or of «البرد», according to the disagreement over the governing word.
The clause «يذهب ...» is in the position of accusative, predicate of the defective verb «يكاد».

* Morphology:
(ركاما), a name for a thing piled up; its pattern is فعال, derived from «ركم الشيء», when one gathers it, of the bāb of نصر.
(الودق), a name for rain, little or much; it is originally the maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ودق; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(برد), a name for frozen water descending from the sky; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(سنا), a name for light, especially that of lightning. It contains a phonological change (iʿlāl) by substitution: its origin is سنو, its verb سنا يسنو; the wāw was vowelled after a fatḥa and changed into alif.

* Rhetoric:
1- The device of the heading (fann al-ʿunwān): in the words of the Exalted «أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزْجِي سَحاباً» to the end of the verse.
This is a device singled out by only a few scholars of rhetoric, namely the device of the heading. They defined it as the speaker taking up some purpose of his — description, boasting, praise, reproach, satire or other genres — and then, to complete and reinforce it, bringing examples of words that serve as headings for earlier reports and past stories. Of it there is a very great kind, which serves as a heading for the sciences: that is, to mention in speech words that are keys to sciences and entrances to them. The verse before us contains the heading of the science known as meteorology (al-āthār al-ʿulwiyya), mathematical geography and astronomy.
2- The eloquent simile (al-tashbīh al-balīgh): in the words of the Exalted «مِنْ جِبالٍ», i.e. from huge pieces resembling mountains in hugeness, by way of the eloquent simile, as in the words of the Exalted «حَتَّى إِذا جَعَلَهُ ناراً»; what is meant by them is pieces of cloud.

* Benefits:
- من جبال:
The scholars disagreed about «من»: whether it is operative or redundant. They also disagreed about what the prepositional phrase is attached to, in several ways, the most important being three:
- The first: that it is partitive.
- The second: explanation of the genus (bayān al-jins).
- The third: that it is redundant.
- And there is a fourth way: that it is for the beginning of the extent.
What we find closest to good taste and shortest in route is to consider it redundant, i.e. «ينزل من السماء جبال برد». This way spares us the attachment, because redundant prepositions, together with their genitive nouns, do not need an attachment.
It is useful to mention to you the prepositions that do not need an attachment; they are five:
a- The redundant preposition, such as «الباء» and «من», as in «كَفى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيداً» and «هَلْ مِنْ خالِقٍ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ». b- «لعلّ» in the dialect of ʿUqayl, because it has the status of a redundant particle.
c- «لولا», for those who say: «لولاي», «لولاك», «لولاه»; Sībawayh holds that what comes after «لولا» is nominative in position, and this is the more correct view. [Translator's note: the source spells these forms as «لو لاي، ولو لاك، ولو لاه».]
d- «ربّ», as in «ربّ رجل صالح لقيت». e- The particles of exception, namely «خلا», «عدا» and «حاشا», when they put what follows them in the genitive.
This is a subject worth reviewing in its proper places in the books of grammar, for it is of great benefit.

safi-cedvel:44-45.t:
* I'rab:
(في ذلك) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ» (اللام) the lām of emphasis (عبرة) noun of «إنّ», accusative (manṣūb) (لأولي) attached to (عبرة).
The clause «يقلّب الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لعبرة» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
45- (الواو) conjunction (من ماء) attached to (خلق), (الفاء) a conjunction of ramification (tafrīʿiyya) (منهم) attached to a fronted predicate of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (من) in the three places (على بطنه) attached to the first (يمشي) (على رجلين) attached to the second (يمشي) (على أربع) attached to the third (يمشي) (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) (على كلّ) attached to (قدير).
The clause «الله خلق ...» has no grammatical position, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «يقلّب».
The clause «خلق ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of the subject (الله).
The clause «منهم من يمشي ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «الله خلق».
The clause «يمشي (the first)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (من).
The clause «منهم من يمشي (the second)» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first clause «منهم من».
The clause «يمشي (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
The clause «منهم من يمشي (the third)» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the first (منهم من..).
The clause «يمشي (the third)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative noun (من).
The clause «يخلق الله ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption reinforcing the content of what preceded.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «إنّ الله ... قدير» has no grammatical position: causal.

* Rhetoric:
1- Figurative usage (al-majāz): in the words of the Exalted «فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلى بَطْنِهِ», such as snakes and fish. Calling their movement "walking", although it is crawling, is a figure for hyperbole in displaying the power [of Allah], and [indicates] that they crawl without an instrument, in something like walking and stronger. What adds to its beauty is the congruence (mushākala) in it, since the crawler is mentioned alongside the walker.
2- Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in the words of the Exalted «مِنْ ماءٍ».
He made «الماء» indefinite, because the meaning is that He created every creature from a kind of water specific to that creature. Or He created it from a particular water, namely the sperm-drop, then made the creatures from the sperm-drop differ: among them are vermin and beasts, and among them are people. So the point, then, is that from one single thing different things came into being by [His] power.
3- Preponderance (al-taghlīb): in the words of the Exalted «فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلى بَطْنِهِ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلى رِجْلَيْنِ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلى أَرْبَعٍ». The pronoun in «منهم» is masculine so that rational beings predominate, and upon their predominance in the pronoun is built the expression with «من» applied to non-rational beings. The apparent sense of some expressions suggests that preponderance is taken into account in (كل دابة), but that is not intended; rather, what is intended is that since this included rational beings and others, by way of mixture, it became necessary to take that into account in the pronoun referring to it and to let rational beings predominate in it.

safi-cedvel:46-46.t:
* I'rab:
(لقد ... أنزلنا آيات مبيّنات): the i'rab of a parallel passage has preceded «[Note: In verse (34) of this sūra.]», (الواو) conjunction (إلى صراط) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يهدي) «[Note: The verb (يهدي) is transitive to the object without a preposition, or with one of the two prepositions (اللام) or (إلى).]».
The clause «أنزلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the implied oath.. and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الله يهدي ...» has no grammatical position, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يهدي ...» is in the position of nominative, khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الله).
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).

safi-cedvel:47-49.t:
* I'rab:
(بالله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنّا), and likewise (بالرسول), (منهم) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (فريق) (من بعد) attached to (يتولّى), (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (ما) negating, operating like «ليس» (المؤمنين) genitive in form by the bāʾ, accusative in position as khabar (predicate) of «ما».
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنّا ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أطعنا ...» is in the position of accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause of the reported speech.
The clause «يتولّى فريق ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «يقولون».
The clause «ما أولئك بالمؤمنين» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «فريق».
48- (الواو) conjunction, and (الواو) in (دعوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) (إلى الله) attached to (دعوا), (اللام) for causation (taʿlīl) (يحكم) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām, and the agent is a pronoun referring to the Messenger — since he is the one who directly gives the judgement — (بينهم) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative, attached to (يحكم).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحكم ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (دعوا).
(إذا) a particle of surprise (fujāʾa) (فريق) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) «[Note: What permitted beginning with an indefinite noun is that it has been described by the prepositional phrase (منهم).]» [Translator's note: the source footnote reads «بالجاور», apparently a misprint for «بالجارّ».], (منهم) attached to an adjective of (فريق) (معرضون) predicate, nominative.
The clause «دعوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يحكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «فريق منهم معرضون» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
49- (الواو) conjunction (لهم) attached to an omitted predicate of «يكن» (إليه) attached to (يأتوا) «[Note: Or attached to «مذعنين».]», (مذعنين), a ḥāl, accusative.
The clause «يكن لهم الحقّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis.
The clause «يأتوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(مذعنين), plural of مذعن, an active participle from the quadriliteral أذعن, meaning "to submit" or "to obey promptly"; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

* Benefits:
- The kinds of «إذا»:
«إذا» comes in three kinds:
a- Explicative «إذا»: it takes the place of the explicative «أي» in sentences, and differs from it in that the verb after «إذا» is for the addressee, as in «استغفرت الله من الذنب إذا سألته الغفران».
b- It comes as an adverb (ẓarfiyya), which is the one that contains the meaning of condition and is an adverb of the future. For that reason it needs a protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and an apodosis, and it is restricted to entering upon verbal sentences; the verb after it is frequently past, and rarely imperfect.
Both are combined in the words of Abū Dhuʾayb:
والنفس راغبة إذا رغبتها ... وإذا ترد إلى قليل تقنع
(The soul is covetous if you make it covet, and if it is brought back to little, it is content.)
When adverbial «إذا» enters upon what is apparently a noun, it is in reality entering upon an omitted verb, as in «إِذَا السَّماءُ انْشَقَّتْ»; the implied form is: «إذا انشقت السماء». So «السماء» is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it.
c- «إذا» of surprise:
It is restricted to nominal sentences, does not need an apodosis, does not occur at the beginning of speech, and its meaning is the present. The preponderant view is that it is a particle, as in the words of the Exalted:
«فَأَلْقاها فَإِذا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعى». It can serve as the answer of the conditional, like the fāʾ; Allah the Exalted said:
«وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِما قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ». Concerning «إذا» there are interpretations and disagreements, which you will find in the lengthy books of grammar.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for rhetorical-denial interrogation (istifhām inkārī) (في قلوبهم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (مرض) (أم) is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning «بل» plus the hamza, in both places (عليهم) attached to (يحيف).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحيف ...) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governing word being «يخافون» (بل) for transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī) (هم) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a detached pronoun as subject, whose predicate is «الظالمون», and the nominal clause «هم الظالمون» is the predicate of the subject (أولئك).]».
The clause «في قلوبهم مرض ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ارتابوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يخافون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يحيف الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «أولئك.. الظالمون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

safi-cedvel:51-53.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) the restraining «ما» and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa) (قول) khabar (predicate) of «كان», accusative (manṣūb) (إذا دعوا ...
بينهم): its i'rab has preceded «[Note: In verse (48) of this sūra.]», (الواو) resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar (أن يقولوا..) is in the position of nominative as the postponed noun of «كان».
The clause «كان قول ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «دعوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. «فإنّما قولهم سمعنا..» «[Note: The adverb (إذا) may be stripped of the conditional sense, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قول).]».
The clause «يحكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «يقولوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the stated particle relative (أن).
The clause «سمعنا ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أطعنا ...» is in the position of accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «سمعنا».
The clause «أولئك.. المفلحون» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: It may be parenthetical between the conjoined clauses.]».
52- 53- (الواو) conjunction (بالله) attached to (أقسموا), (جهد) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being synonymous with it in the verb or explaining its kind, accusative «[Note: It may be accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), interpreted as a derived word, i.e. «جاهدين».]», (اللام) the lām that prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam) (أمرت) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) (اللام) the second is the lām of the oath (يخرجنّ) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters, and the (الواو), dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing (طاعة) mubtadaʾ (subject) «[Note: It may be the predicate of an omitted subject, i.e.: «أمرنا طاعة معروفة».]», its predicate being omitted, i.e. «better than your oath» (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, the referring pronoun being omitted, i.e. «تعملونه».. and the clause after it is its ṣila.]».
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the predicate (خبير).
The clause «من يطع ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «إنّما كان قول..».
The clause «يطع ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of the subject (من).
The clause «يخش ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «يطع».
The clause «يتّقه ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «يطع».
The clause «أولئك.. الفائزون» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «أقسموا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «إنّما كان قول..». [Translator's note: the source reads «وجملة: «وجملة أقسموا ...»», with the word «وجملة» duplicated inside the quotation.]
The clause «إن أمرتهم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or an explanation of the content of the oath.
The clause «يخرجنّ ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to an implied oath.. and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا تقسموا ...» is in the position of accusative as the reported speech.
The clause «طاعة معروفة (خير)» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «إنّ الله خبير» has no grammatical position: another statement of cause.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(معروفة), feminine of معروف, a passive participle from the triliteral عرف; its pattern is مفعول and مفعولة.

* Rhetoric:
Metaphor (al-istiʿāra): in the words of the Exalted «جَهْدَ أَيْمانِهِمْ».
The meaning of «جهد اليمين» is reaching its utmost, by way of metaphor, from their saying «جهد نفسه» when one reaches the utmost of one's capacity and ability. What is meant is: they swore, reaching the furthest degrees of the oath in vehemence and firmness.

* Benefits:
- Fronting the predicate of «kāna and its sisters» before their noun: it is permissible to front the predicate of these verbs before their nouns, as in «وكان حقا علينا نصر المؤمنين», unless something prevents it, such as the restriction (ḥaṣr) of the predicate, as in:
«وَما كانَ صَلاتُهُمْ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكاءً وَتَصْدِيَةً», or because their i'rab is not apparent, as in:
«أكرم موسى عيسى»; then the noun is placed first and the predicate after..
And placing it in the middle may be obligatory, as in «كان في الدار ساكنها».

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) the first is resumptive, and the second links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) — or is causal — (إنّما) the restraining «ما» and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa) (عليه) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) — in both places — the referring pronoun being omitted, i.e. «حمّله» and «حمّلتموه».]» in both places, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb (حمّل) is a pronoun referring to the Messenger..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما حمّل..) is in the position of nominative as a postponed subject.
(عليكم ما حمّلتم) like «عليه ما حمّل», (الواو) conjunction, and the second is resumptive (ما) negating, inoperative (muhmala) (على الرسول) attached to a fronted predicate (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) (البلاغ) postponed subject.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أطيعوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أطيعوا (the second)» is in the position of accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first clause «أطيعوا».
The clause «تولّوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.. and the apodosis is implied, i.e.:
«فلا ضرر عليه» «[Note: The verb (تولّوا) may be past, or it may be imperfect with one of the two tāʾs dropped; the imperfect is more evident, since the verb (تطيعوه) comes conjoined to it.]».
The clause «عليه ما حمّل ...» has no grammatical position, being a statement of cause for the implied apodosis «[Note: The clause may be the apodosis itself, in the position of jussive.]».
The clause «حمّل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما).
The clause «عليكم ما حمّلتم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «عليه ما حمّل».
The clause «حمّلتم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle relative (ما).
The clause «تطيعوه ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «إن تولّوا..».
The clause «تهتدوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ما على الرسول إلّا البلاغ» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the third-person pronoun in (تطيعوه).]».

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab:
The second object of (وعد) is omitted, i.e. «He promised them succession (al-istikhlāf) and establishment» (منكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «آمنوا» (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath «[Note: The word of promise may be treated like an oath, so that the response to the oath is a response to (وعد الله..).]», (في الأرض) attached to (يستخلفنّهم), (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما استخلف..) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governing word is (يستخلفنّ).
(من قبلهم) attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين), (الواو) conjunction (ليمكننّ) like «ليستخلفنّ» (لهم) attached to (يمكننّ), and the second (لهم) attached to (ارتضى), (الواو) conjunction (ليبدّلنّهم) like «ليمكننّ» (من بعد) attached to (يبدّلنّهم), (أمنا) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the second (النون) in (يعبدونني) is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya) (بي) attached to (يشركون), (الواو) conjunction (بعد) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative, attached to (كفر), (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (هم) for separation (faṣl) «[Note: Or it is a detached pronoun as mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is «الفاسقون».. and the nominal clause is the predicate of the subject (أولئك).]».
The clause «وعد الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يستخلفنّهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the implied oath.
The clause «استخلف ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما).
The clause «يمكّننّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath.
The clause «ارتضى ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «يبدّلنّهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath.
The clause «يعبدونني ...» is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of the object of «يبدّلنّهم» «[Note: The clause may be a ḥāl of the object of «وعد», or of the object of «يستخلفنّهم», or of its agent, or of the agent of «يبدّلنّهم».]».
The clause «لا يشركون ...» is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl of the agent of «يعبدون».
The clause «من كفر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «وعد الله».
The clause «كفر ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of the subject (من).
The clause «أولئك.. الفاسقون» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.

* Benefits:
The narrators agree that the Messenger (may Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) remained in Mecca, he and his Companions, for ten years in fear.
When they emigrated to Medina, they would rise in the morning with weapons and go to bed in the evening with weapons, until one of them said: «Will a day ever come upon us on which we are safe and lay down our weapons?». So the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) said: «You will not remain [so] but a little while, until a man among you sits in the great assembly, his knees drawn up in his garment (muḥtabiyan), with no iron [weapon] on him».
So Allah fulfilled His promise, made them prevail over the Arabian Peninsula; they conquered the lands of the East and the West, tore apart the kingdom of the Chosroes, took possession of their treasuries and gained mastery over the world.. So let whoever would take heed take heed ...

safi-cedvel:56-56.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, and the second and third are conjunctions, and (الواو) in (ترحمون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «أقيموا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: Some exegetes conjoined it to His words: «أطيعوا الله ...» in verse (54) of this sūra, so that it is in the position of accusative.]».
The clause «آتوا ...» has no grammatical position, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أطيعوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لعلّكم ترحمون» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or causal (taʿlīliyya) — and the clause «ترحمون» is in the position of nominative, khabar (predicate) of «لعلّ».

safi-cedvel:57-57.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing (تحسبنّ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm), and the agent is «أنت» (معجزين) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ (في الأرض) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (معجزين) (الواو) conjunction, and the second is resumptive (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied (muqaddar) oath (بئس) an invariable (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame (المصير) fāʿil (agent) of «بئس», nominative (marfūʿ), and the one specifically blamed (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted.
The clause «لا تحسبنّ ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «مأواهم النار ...» has no grammatical position, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.:
«بل هم مقهورون ومأواهم النار» «[Note: It may be conjoined to the performative (inshāʾī) resumptive clause even though it is declarative (khabar).]».
The clause «بئس المصير» has no grammatical position, being the response to an implied oath.

safi-cedvel:58-60.t:
* I'rab:
(أيّها) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative (الذين) badal (substitute) of «أيّ», in the position of accusative (اللام) the lām of command (الذين), the second, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first relative noun, agent of «يستأذن», in the position of nominative (منكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «يبلغوا» (ثلاث) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being its number «[Note: Some made it an adverb (ẓarf), because it is explained by the times of dawn, midday and the night (ʿishāʾ) [prayer].]», (من قبل) attached to (يستأذنكم), (حين) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (يستأذنكم), (من الظهيرة) attached to (تضعون), and (من) is either for explaining the genus (bayān al-jins), i.e. «of the time of midday», or causal, i.e. «because of the heat of midday» (من بعد) attached to (يستأذنكم), (ثلاث) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هي» or «هذه», with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e.: «أوقات ثلاث عورات» (لكم) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (عورات), (عليكم) attached to the predicate of «ليس» (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation (عليهم) like the first and conjoined to it (جناح) the postponed noun of «ليس», nominative (marfūʿ) (بعدهنّ) an adverb, accusative, attached to the [notion of] existence (al-istiqrār) to which «عليكم» and «عليهم» are attached (طوّافون) predicate of an omitted subject, its implied form being «هم» (عليكم) attached to (طوّافون) (بعضكم) subject, whose predicate is the prepositional phrase (على بعض) «[Note: I.e. «طائف على بعض»; nothing prevents the omitted predicate from being a specific state of being (kawn khāṣṣ), since what precedes indicates it.]», (كذلك) attached to an omitted absolute object whose governing word is «يبيّن» (لكم) attached to (يبيّن), (الواو) parenthetical — or circumstantial — (حكيم) a second predicate, nominative.
The clause «the vocative and its response ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يستأذنكم الذين» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «ملكت أيمانكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لم يبلغوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين).
The clause «تضعون ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ليس عليكم ... جناح» is in the position of nominative, an adjective of «ثلاث».. or in the position of genitive, an adjective of «عورات».
The clause «(هي) ثلاث ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the vocative.
The clause «(هم) طوّافون ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «بعضكم على بعض» has no grammatical position, a badal of the clause «هم طوّافون».
The clause «يبيّن الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الله عليم ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical — or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl — «[Note: Or resumptive, having the force of a statement of cause (taʿlīl).]».
59- (الواو) conjunction (منكم) attached to a ḥāl of «الأطفال» (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (اللام) the lām of command (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (من قبلهم) attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun (الذين)..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما استأذن) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted absolute object whose governing word is «يستأذنوا»; (كذلك يبيّن ... عليم حكيم): the i'rab of a parallel passage has preceded in the previous verse.
The clause «بلغ الأطفال ...» is in the position of muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: the source omits the word «جرّ» (genitive) here.]
The clause «يستأذنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «استأذن الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما).
The clause «يبيّن الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الله عليم» has no grammatical position: parenthetical — or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl — «[Note: Or resumptive, having the force of a statement of cause.]».
60- (الواو) conjunction (من النساء) a ḥāl of «القواعد» (اللاتي) a relative noun in the position of nominative, an adjective of «القواعد» (لا) negating (يرجون) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (النون) is a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent) (الفاء) redundant «[Note: The reason for the redundancy of the fāʾ is that the subject is described by the relative noun, which could properly be the subject if the subject were omitted, and it resembles a condition; or because «ال» in «القواعد» is a relative noun.]», (عليهنّ) attached to the predicate of «ليس» (جناح) the postponed noun of «ليس», nominative (يضعن) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative by «أن».. and (النون) is the agent.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يضعن..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted (في), attached to (جناح), i.e. «في أن يضعن».
(غير) a ḥāl, accusative, of the nūn in (يضعن), (بزينة) attached to (متبرّجات) (الواو) conjunction (أن يستعففن) like «أن يضعن» (لهنّ) attached to (خير), (الواو) resumptive.. and the interpreted maṣdar (أن يستعففن) is in the position of nominative as a subject whose predicate is (خير).
The clause «القواعد.. ليس عليهنّ» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «إذا بلغ ...», consisting of the condition, its verb and its apodosis, which is conjoined to the clause of the response to the vocative.
The clause «لا يرجون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (اللاتي).
The clause «ليس عليهنّ جناح ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of the subject (القواعد)..
The clause «يضعن ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «(الاستعفاف) خير لهنّ» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يستعففن ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «الله سميع ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption having the force of a statement of cause.

* Morphology:
(الحلم), a name for puberty, or a maṣdar (verbal noun) of the triliteral حلم يحلم, of the bāb of نصر; its pattern is فعل, with two ḍammas.
(الظهيرة), a name for the time of noon and the middle of the day; its pattern is فعيلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(طوّافون), plural of طوّاف, an intensive form of the active participle from طاف يطوف; its pattern is فعّال..
(60) القواعد: plural of قاعد — without tāʾ — because it is an attribute of a woman who has ceased (qaʿadat) from menstruation, marriage or pregnancy ...; an active participle from the triliteral قعد; its pattern is فاعل and the plural فواعل.
(متبرّجات), plural of متبرّجة, the feminine of متبرّج, an active participle from the five-letter تبرّج, which is affectation in displaying what is hidden; its pattern is متفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
Reversal of the apparent (ʿaks al-ẓāhir): in the words of the Exalted «غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجاتٍ بِزِينَةٍ».
Some call this device "negating a thing by affirming it", and it is one of the beauties of speech: when you contemplate it, you find its inner sense a negation and its outer form an affirmation; or it is that you mention speech whose apparent sense indicates that it negates an attribute of something described, while it negates the thing described altogether. What is meant here in the verse is «and the elderly women who have no adornment that they might display», because the discourse is about those in this condition. It is as though the purpose of this is that, for these women, their refraining from laying aside their garments is better for them — so what do you think of those who possess adornment of garments? The most eloquent point in this is that He made not laying aside garments, in the case of elderly women, a matter of chastity, as an indication that laying aside garments has no place in chastity. This is about the elderly women, so how [much more] about young maidens?!

* Benefits:
1- The non-declinable adverb (al-ẓarf ghayr al-mutaṣarrif):
The non-declinable adverb is of two kinds:
a- The first kind: that which always keeps the accusative as an adverb and is used only as an accusative adverb, such as «قط», «عوض», «بينا», «بينما», «إذا», «أيان», «أنى», «ذا صباح» and «ذات ليلة»; and of it are compound adverbs, such as «صباح مساء» and «ليل ليل».
b- The second kind: that which keeps the accusative as an adverb, or the genitive by «من», «إلى», «حتى», «مذ» or «منذ», such as «قبل» and «بعد», as in the verse, and likewise «فوق», «تحت», «لدى», «لدن», «عند», «متى», «أين», «هنا», «ثمّ», «حيث» and «الآن». [Translator's note: the source prints «ولدي» here, apparently a misprint for «لدى», which appears correctly in the next paragraph.]
«قبل» and «بعد» are put in the genitive, among the prepositions, by «من»; «فوق» and «تحت» by «من» and «إلى»; «لدى», «لدن» and «عند» by «من»; «متى» by «إلى» and «حتى»; «أين», «هنا», «ثمّ» and «حيث» by «من» and «إلى», and «حيث» may also be put in the genitive by «في»; and «الآن» by «من», «إلى», «مذ» and «منذ». There are explanations of this.
2- Occasions of revelation (asbāb al-nuzūl):
It was said that Mudlij ibn ʿAmr, a young man of the Anṣār, was sent by the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) to summon ʿUmar at midday. He came in upon him while he was asleep, and his garment had slipped off him. ʿUmar said:
«I wish that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, had forbidden our fathers, our sons and our servants to come in upon us at these hours except with permission». Then he went with him to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) and found him with this verse having been revealed. It is one of the verses revealed on account of ʿUmar.
It was said: it was revealed concerning Asmāʾ bint Abī Marthad.
And it was said: it was revealed on account of a Bedouin who looked into the house of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace) through the chinks of the door. Events may recur while the cause remains one, so reflect.

safi-cedvel:61-61.t:
* I'rab:
(ليس على الأعمى حرج) like «ليس عليكم ... جناح» «[Note: In verse (58) of this sūra.]», and likewise (على الأعرج حرج، على المريض حرج), which is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the khabar (predicate) of «ليس» and its noun, and (لا) is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation, in the three places (على أنفسكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) what (على الأعمى) is attached to, since it is conjoined to it «[Note: It was said that (لا) here is the lā of generic negation, its noun being omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. «لا حرج على أنفسكم», and the prepositional phrase is the predicate of «لا».]», (من بيوتكم) attached to (تأكلوا), (أو) a conjunction for permission (ibāḥa) in the ten places, and the annexed nouns between the conjunctions are conjoined to one another, genitive (majrūr)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تأكلوا..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (حرج), i.e. «حرج في أن تأكلوا».
(جميعا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of «تأكلوا», accusative (manṣūba) (أو) a conjunction for choice (takhyīr) (أشتاتا) conjoined to (جميعا), accusative (الفاء) conjunction, and the second links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (على أنفسكم) attached to (سلّموا) (تحيّة) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, being synonymous with it (من عند) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (تحيّة), (كذلك يبيّن ...
تعقلون): the i'rab of a parallel passage has preceded «[Note: In verses (56, 58) of this sūra.]».
The clause «ليس على الأعمى حرج ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تأكلوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «ملكتم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «ليس عليكم جناح» has no grammatical position: resumptive and reinforcing.
The clause «تأكلوا (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).
The clause «دخلتم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «سلّموا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of the non-jussive condition.
The clause «يبيّن الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لعلّكم تعقلون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) — or causal (taʿlīliyya) — and the clause «تعقلون» is in the position of nominative, predicate of «لعلّ».

* Morphology:
(الأعرج), an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral عرج, of the bāb of فرح and the bāb of فتح; its pattern is أفعل, and the feminine is «عرجاء», on the pattern فعلاء.
(أعمام), plural of «عمّ», the name for the father's brother; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn, and the ʿayn and lām are the same letter.
(أخوال), plural of «خال», the name for the mother's brother; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas. It contains a phonological change (iʿlāl) by substitution: its origin is خول; the wāw was vowelled after a fatḥa and changed into alif.
(صديق), an adjective resembling the participle from the triliteral صدق, of the bāb of نصر; its pattern is فعيل. Its plural is «أصدقاء» and «صدقاء», with ḍamma on the ṣād and fatḥa on the dāl, and «صدقان», with ḍamma then sukūn; the plural of the plural is «أصادق», on the pattern أفاعل; its feminine is «صديقة», on the pattern فعيلة.. It was said that «صديق» is used for the singular and the plural.
(أشتاتا), plural of «شتّ», which is a maṣdar (verbal noun) used as an adjective; its verb is «شتّ الأمر يشتّ», with kasra, of the bāb of ضرب, meaning "to be scattered"; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn, and the ʿayn and lām are the same letter.. «شتّى» is the plural of «شتيت», like «مرضى», the plural of «مريض»; and the pattern of «أشتات» is أفعال.

* Benefits:
- One of the forms of removing hardship:
There are several views on the interpretation of this verse, from which we select for you:
a- These categories [of people] felt uneasy about eating together with the sighted and the healthy, so this verse was revealed, removing the hardship from them.
b- It was said: it was revealed concerning people with disabilities, who used to be taken to the houses of their relatives to eat, and they felt uneasy about that, so this verse was revealed concerning them.
c- It was said: it was revealed to remove hardship from those whom they would leave in charge of their houses and property during military expeditions.
d- It was said that it was revealed as a dispensation for these groups of people to stay behind from jihad. And Allah knows best.

safi-cedvel:62-62.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) the restraining «ما» and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa) (الذين) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (المؤمنون) (بالله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنوا), (الواو) conjunction (معه) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to the predicate of «كانوا» (حتّى) a particle of limit and genitive (يستأذنوه) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after «حتّى».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يستأذنوه..) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (لم يذهبوا), (أولئك) subject whose predicate is (الذين) (بالله), the second, attached to (يؤمنون), (الفاء) conjunction (لبعض) attached to (استأذنوك), (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) (لمن) attached to (ائذن), (منهم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted referring pronoun, i.e.: «شئت إذنه منهم» (لهم) attached to (استغفر), (رحيم) a second predicate of (إنّ).
The clause «المؤمنون الذين ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «كانوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لم يذهبوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يستأذنوه ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «إنّ الذين ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يستأذنونك ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أولئك الذين ...» is in the position of nominative, predicate of «إنّ».
The clause «يؤمنون بالله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين).
The clause «استأذنوك ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ائذن ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «شئت ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «استغفر ...» has no grammatical position, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «ائذن».
The clause «إنّ الله غفور ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, having the force of a statement of cause (taʿlīl).

safi-cedvel:63-64.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing (بينكم) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «دعاء الرسول» (كدعاء) attached to a second object (بعضا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar «دعاء», accusative (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq) (منكم) attached to a ḥāl of the agent of «يتسلّلون», i.e. «from your group» (لواذا) a maṣdar in the position of a ḥāl «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, coinciding with the verb in meaning, i.e. «يتسلّلون» in the sense of «يلاوذون».]», (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition (اللام) the lām of command, and the sign of the jussive in (يحذر) is the sukūn, given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters (عن أمره) attached to (يخالفون), by making it imply the meaning of «يصدّون».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تصيبهم ...) is in the position of accusative as direct object, its governing word being «يحذر».
(أو) a conjunction (يصيبهم) imperfect verb, accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (تصيبهم).
The clause «لا تجعلوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قد يعلم الله ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يتسلّلون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «ليحذر ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. «إن يعلم الله أفعالكم فليحذر الذين ...» «[Note: The relationship between this clause and the one before it (قد يعلم الله..) is that of effect to cause.]»....
The clause «يخالفون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «تصيبهم فتنة ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «يصيبهم عذاب» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause «تصيبهم فتنة».
64- (ألا) a particle of alerting (tanbīh) (لله) attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as the noun of «إنّ» (في السموات) attached to an omitted ṣila of «ما» (قد يعلم) like the first (عليه) attached to the predicate of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (أنتم) (الواو) conjunction (يوم) conjoined to the relative noun that is the object (ما أنتم..), and (الواو) in (يرجعون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), in the position of nominative (الفاء) conjunction (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (ينبّئهم), the referring pronoun being omitted (بكلّ) attached to the predicate (عليم).
The clause «إنّ لله ما في السموات ...» has no grammatical position, having the force of a statement of cause for what preceded.
The clause «قد يعلم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «أنتم عليه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يرجعون ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ينبّئهم ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «يرجعون».
The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «الله ... عليم» has no grammatical position: causal.

* Morphology:
(لواذا), a maṣdar (verbal noun) known by hearing (samāʿī) of the triliteral «لاذ بالقوم», i.e. he took refuge with them; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ. There are other maṣdars, among them «لوذ», and «لواذ» with all three vowels on the lām.

* Benefits:
1- On the etiquette of assemblies:
Although this verse was revealed alluding to the conduct of the hypocrites and their violation of the etiquette of assemblies, it lays down an order for this etiquette. For it is not permissible for one who is summoned to a meeting in which some public and important matter is discussed to leave whenever he wishes, without asking permission of the one supervising the running of the meeting, who is responsible for convening it and for its order. No one acts in this way except an eccentric man who gives no weight to social etiquette.
2- We spoke earlier about «قد» in detail. We now return to stress that when it enters upon the imperfect it conveys paucity and has the meaning of «ربما» (perhaps, sometimes). Of this is the saying of Zuhayr ibn Abī Sulmā:
أخي ثقة لا تهلك الخمر ماله ... ولكنه قد يهلك المال نائله
(A trustworthy man whose wealth wine does not destroy, but whose generosity at times destroys his wealth.)
«الثقة»: from «وثق»; its fāʾ was dropped because it is from a verb weak in the fāʾ, «al-mithāl», and the closed tāʾ (tāʾ marbūṭa) was given in compensation for it; like it are «وعد» → «عدة».

safi-cedvel:1-1.t:
* I'rab:
(سورة) predicate (khabar) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being «هذه» ("this") [Note: or a mubtadaʾ whose predicate is omitted and placed first, i.e. "in what is recited to you is a sūra".], (فيها) attached to (أنزلنا). The sign of the accusative in (آيات) is the kasra. (تذكّرون) an imperfect verb from which one of the two tāʾs has been dropped.
Clause: «(هذه) سورة» has no grammatical position, being an inceptive clause.
Clause: «أنزلناها ... » is in the position of a nominative, an adjective of سورة.
Clause: «فرضناها ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause أنزلناها.
Clause: «أنزلنا فيها ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause أنزلناها.
Clause: «لعلّكم تذكّرون» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
Clause: «تذكّرون» is in the position of a nominative, predicate of لعلّ.

safi-cedvel:2-3.t:
* I'rab:
(الزانية) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "the ruling on the adulteress"; and the predicate is implied: "in what is recited to you" [Note: it is permissible that the predicate be the clause اجلدوا, with the fāʾ added, because the (ال) in the mubtadaʾ is a relative noun, resembling a condition.]. (الفاء) links to the apodosis of an implied condition. (منهما) attached to an adjective of (كلّ). (مائة) an absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq) standing in for the maṣdar, being its number. (الواو) is conjunctive. (لا) is a prohibitive, jussive lā. (بهما) attached to a ḥāl from (رأفة), the agent of (تأخذكم) [Note: or attached to (تأخذكم), the (الباء) being causal; it is not valid to attach it to رأفة, because the governor of a maṣdar does not precede it.]. (في دين) attached to the verb تأخذكم. (كنتم) a defective past verb - a naskh verb - in the position of a jussive, the protasis. (بالله) attached to (تؤمنون). (الواو) is conjunctive. (اللام) is the lām of command. (من المؤمنين) attached to an adjective of (طائفة).
Clause: «(في ما يتلى عليكم، حكم) الزانية» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
Clause: «اجلدوا ... » is in the position of a jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you believe in Allah and you punish the two, then flog".. [Note: or it is the predicate of the mubtadaʾ الزانية.].
Clause: «لا تأخذكم بهما رأفة ... » is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause اجلدوا.
Clause: «كنتم ... » has no grammatical position, being an explanation of the implied conditional clause [Note: or it is parenthetical between the two conjoined clauses.].
Clause: «تؤمنون بالله ... » is in the position of an accusative, predicate of كنتم.. The apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if you believe in Allah, then punish the adulteress and the adulterer".
Clause: «يشهد.. طائفة» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause اجلدوا.
3- (إلّا) is for restriction in both places. (زان) agent of (ينكحها), nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the omitted yāʾ, for it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ). (ذلك) deputy agent, in the position of a nominative. (على المؤمنين) attached to (حرّم).
Clause: «الزاني لا ينكح ... » has no grammatical position, being a causal resumption.
Clause: «لا ينكح ... » is in the position of a nominative, predicate of the mubtadaʾ (الزاني).
Clause: «الزانية لا ينكحها ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
Clause: «لا ينكحها إلّا زان ... » is in the position of a nominative, predicate of the mubtadaʾ (الزانية).
Clause: «حرّم ذلك ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(الزانية- الزاني): an active participle from the triliteral verb زنى, for the feminine and the masculine; its pattern is فاعلة - فاعل.
(جلدة): a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra) from the triliteral verb جلد, meaning "he struck with the whip"; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(رأفة): a maṣdar of the triliteral verb رأف, bāb فتح; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(زان): it contains an alteration by omission (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf). Its origin is الزاني - with yāʾ at the end - and when it became indefinite, two sukūns met, namely the yāʾ and the sukūn of the tanwīn, so the yāʾ was dropped on account of the meeting of two sukūns. Its pattern is فاع.

* Rhetoric:
Prohibition and condition, for arousing:
In His saying, the Exalted, «وَلا تَأْخُذْكُمْ بِهِما رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ».
The meaning: it is incumbent upon the believers to be firm in the religion of Allah, to use earnestness and steadfastness in it, and not to let leniency and slackness seize them in carrying out its penalties in full.
And the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, is sufficient as an example in that, when he said: "If Fāṭima, daughter of Muḥammad, were to steal, I would cut off her hands",
as it is said: "If you are a man, do such-and-such", with no doubt about his manhood. So too those addressed here: their faith is certain, but the aim is to arouse them and stir their zeal, so that they strive in obedience to Allah the Exalted and exert themselves to carry out His rulings properly.

* Benefits:
«وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذابَهُما طائِفَةٌ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ» On the authority of Ibn ʿAbbās in the interpretation of this verse, the "group" (ṭāʾifa) is four to forty men of those who affirm belief in Allah; on the authority of al-Ḥasan, ten; on the authority of Qatāda, three or more; on the authority of ʿIkrima, two men or more. Perhaps Ibn ʿAbbās's view is the soundest, because four is the group by whom the penalty is established, so four witnesses are matched by four observers of the punishment.

safi-cedvel:4-10.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive. (الذين) a relative, mubtadaʾ, whose predicate is the clause اجلدوهم; the sign of the accusative of (المحصنات) is the kasra. (ثم) is a conjunction. (بأربعة) attached to (يأتوا). (شهداء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, for it is a diptote because it is attached to the feminine ending in the extended alif of femininity, on the pattern فعلاء. (الفاء) is redundant (zāʾida). (ثمانين) an absolute object standing in for the maṣdar, being its number. (جلدة) tamyīz, accusative. (الواو) is conjunctive. (لا) is a prohibitive, jussive lā. (لهم) attached to (تقبلوا). (أبدا) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تقبلوا). (هم) a pronoun of separation [Note: or a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose predicate is الفاسقون, the nominal clause being the predicate of أولئك.].
Clause: «الذين يرمون ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
Clause: «يرمون ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
Clause: «لم يأتوا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
Clause: «اجلدوهم ... » is in the position of a nominative, predicate of the mubtadaʾ (الذين); the fāʾ was added because the relative resembles a condition.
Clause: «لا تقبلوا ... » is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause اجلدوهم.
Clause: «أولئك.. الفاسقون ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: or parenthetical between the excepted and that from which it is excepted.. It may also be a ḥāl from the pronoun in (لهم).].
5- (إلّا) is a particle of exception. (الذين) excepted by إلّا, in the position of an accusative [Note: and that from which it is excepted is: الذين يرمون.. and it is in the position of a genitive, a substitute for the pronoun in (لهم), if that is what is excepted from. Al-ʿUkbarī permitted that the relative be a mubtadaʾ whose predicate is the clause إنّ الله غفور, with an omitted pronoun in the clause, i.e. "forgiving to them".], (من بعد) attached to (تابوا). (الفاء) is causal. (رحيم) a second predicate of (إنّ).
